mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of regime conditions.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declined over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 3.0% for three consecutive months, restrictive monetary policy increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 3.0% for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment rate and increases in non-farm payrolls signal a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 6.0% year-over-year), aggressive Fed tightening reduces equity valuations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 6.0% yoy, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in non-farm payrolls over the prior 3 months indicates strengthening labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS increased over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0% for two consecutive months, economic weakness reduces corporate earnings expectations and generates negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE > 4.0% for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and industrial production signal a broad-based economic slowdown that reduces earnings growth expectations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST declines and INDPRO declines, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: In high consumer demand regimes (RSAFS > 700,000 million dollars), strong retail sales support revenue growth and generate positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where RSAFS > 700000, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year period.
